answer.reason: EZR 8 states two events of this Levite, his coming to Ezra and his being set apart to carry the offering, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was brought to Ezra with his brethren as ministers for the house of God
clauses.quote: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari

clauses.english: was set apart to carry the silver, gold and vessels offered for the house of God
clauses.quote: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah

doubts: NEH 3:17 (Hashabiah, ruler of half of Keilah, repaired the wall) may concern a different Hashabiah, so it was left out.
EZR 8:24 calls the twelve 'chief of the priests' although Hashabiah is a Levite; the verse was used as given.
NEH 10:11 only lists the name, and NEH 12:24 gives a Levite office already covered by the summary.
